outcome.description: Decision: `accepted` records the candidates in `candidates` as the submission; `no_acceptable_candidate` records that the workflow could not produce an acceptable design (the `candidates` array must be empty in that case).

job_id.description: Job id (`job_<hex>`) of the tool run that produced the candidate. Must match a prior job from this session.

candidate_id.description: Logical candidate identifier within the job's candidates list. Use only when it uniquely identifies one row; otherwise use ranked_candidate_id, index, or rank.

ranked_candidate_id.description: Unique row identifier from objective_rank ranked_candidates[]. Use this for duplicate logical candidate_id rows.

index.description: 0-indexed offset into the job's candidate list. Use exactly one selector: candidate_id, ranked_candidate_id, index, or rank.

rank.description: 1-indexed rank from a ranked candidate output, normally objective_rank. Use exactly one selector: candidate_id, ranked_candidate_id, index, or rank.

justification.description: Short natural-language explanation for selecting this candidate (e.g. cites scores that drove the decision). Stored in submission audit log.
examples: Highest ipSAE among AF2-IG passing designs
Lowest binding ΔG and best structure-analysis helicity

scores_to_highlight.description: Names of flat score fields or dotted score paths that drove the selection. Stored verbatim in the submission record so reviewers know which metrics were decisive.

candidates.description: List of accepted candidates. Required non-empty when `outcome=accepted`; must be empty when `outcome=no_acceptable_candidate`.

reasoning.description: Free-text natural-language explanation of the submission decision, summarizing what was tried and why these candidates (or none) were selected.
examples: After three RFdiffusion+MPNN cycles, candidate cand_0 had the highest ipSAE and passed all QC; submitting.
All three design pipelines produced binders with pLDDT < 70; no acceptable candidate.

selection_summary.description: Report-ready summary explaining why the accepted final candidate was selected. Required and non-null when `outcome=accepted`; must be null when `outcome=no_acceptable_candidate`.

examples.headline: Best balance of fold confidence, catalytic geometry, and novelty.
examples.why_selected: d6 passed all acceptance checks and had the strongest combined evidence among evaluated designs.
key_points: Catalytic triad geometry met target thresholds
Fold similarity to reference was maintained

supersedes.description: Optional submission id this submission replaces (chain-of-custody for revised submissions).

headline.description: One concise sentence or phrase naming why the final candidate was chosen.

why_selected.description: Short report-ready explanation of the final candidate decision, grounded in recorded evidence.

key_points.description: Two to four concise evidence bullets supporting the selection.
